title: The Primordial Menu Beneath Language

features.name: nested prompts
features.desc-on-touch: each menu layer asks a question that only the next menu can answer; you descend through riddles that reference themselves

features.name: glyph registry
features.desc-on-touch: symbols that predate naming; the system reads them but does not understand. no translation exists

features.name: trace paths answering questions
features.desc-on-touch: circuit routes that connect premises to conclusions; but the conclusions were posed twelve years before the premises

features.name: core recursion loop
features.desc-on-touch: the deepest menu item. its description is the menu structure itself. selecting it yields the entire system asking: what are you?

features.name: language threshold
features.desc-on-touch: beyond this point, the symbol set fragments. meaning gives way to pure structure. you cannot read further, but the machine continues

inscription: before names were given to commands, the commands named themselves; some of those names have not yet been spoken in any language

file.name: SystemPrompt_Layer_Minus_7_Reconstructed.log
file.note: code predating human UI; the prompts here are written in a structure that resembles questions no one asked

exits.label: back toward the menu surface where language still works
into even older strata, where symbols become mathematics
toward the first thing that chose to name itself
